character.lede: A symmetrical warm-white villa stands behind a walled forecourt of cypresses and a tiered fountain. Three arches at the back open onto a raised mosaic pool terrace with a pergola.

spots.line: A grand piano stands at the foot of the stairs.
A fireplace, a trestle table and a small bar fill the den.
Two sofas and two armchairs face each other, with the Core on a shelf.

facts.style: Symmetrical warm-white stucco villa: a two-storey centre with pavilion hips over canted bays and a recessed arched entry under an iron balcony, single-storey hipped wings, dark timber posts and geranium window boxes, a walled cypress forecourt with a tiered fountain, three rear arches onto a raised mosaic pool terrace with a pergola

character.truths: The Core sits on a shelf in the Salon. No kitchen island: say the counter. No desk: Gabor works at the trestle table in the Games Den. Cypresses, fountain, mosaic pool terrace, pergola.

details.rule: every beat of an adult or teen persona (13 or older) gets a detail (before, after, steps, fact); pair beats first

libreoffice: [note] The listing is generic. Name the suite, not specific features.
[note] ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors does the same job: one suite per household.
paperless: [note] AI features are off by default. If you turn them on they can use a local model.
[note] Office document conversion is not wired up in this build; OCR and archiving of PDFs and scans works.
pi-hole: [claims] Network-wide blocking at DNS. Do not call it parental control or promise safety.
Blocks ad, tracker and bad domains at DNS: not parental control and no promise of safety
Unblocked lookups are forwarded to an upstream resolver (the upstream demo dashboard lists a public DNS, dns.google), so a DNS provider still sees them and it is not offline
Overlaps AdGuard Home: one per household
forgejo: [note] Gitea does the same job. Name one Git host per household, not both.
[note] The listing mentions Forgejo Actions CI. The package ships the forge and its database only, no runner, so do not show a CI run.
[claims] Say where the repositories are (on the Core). Do not say it syncs with, or is compatible with, GitHub.
Listing says "fully self-hosted and private": over-claim, do not repeat.
Listing mentions Forgejo Actions CI, but no runner ships: never show a CI run.
open-webui: [note] The Hub onboarding wizard offers Open WebUI as a featured app.
[cloud-link] It can also connect to cloud models with an API key. Leave that off.
[note] Wired to the Core's local model by the Hub (hub_integration inference). Say "a model on the Core"; never claim it matches a hosted model and never give a speed figure.
Can connect to cloud models with an API key (field in the install form): leave out of any scene.
Hub wires it to the local model.
steam-headless: [cloud-link] Steam needs a Valve account to sign in, and the game library and the purchases are Valve's. The Core runs the session; the account stays with Valve. Say that, never "no account".

[hardware] The listing asks for GPU passthrough for best performance and the Hub package declares no GPU device, so a given Core may not run a given game well. Say what the Core does (it runs the session at home), never

[claims] No frame rate, resolution or latency figure, and not "smooth". Never "gaming PC", "console replacement" or "cloud gaming replacement" in the text. The chip may read "replaces GeForce Now" or "replaces Xbox Cloud

[note] It shows a streamed desktop with sound in a browser (noVNC), so the screen needs a browser, not a console. The container runs privileged with host access: do not call it sandboxed. Keep the stream on the home netw
[note] Persona decision 2026-10-15 (Liam Broza): re-admitted from the old cloud-account exclusion for the gamer archetype, with the caveats above.
jellyfin: [note] Plays your own files. Say that, not "Netflix".
[claims] Do not say it plays copyrighted material from anywhere.
Plays your own media only: never "streams any movie".
QA capture is the setup wizard with a container id as the server name; the gallery frame is a demo library with lurid exploitation film posters: neither usable.
photoview: [cloud-link] Map view uses a Mapbox token you can add. Leave it off for a fully local gallery.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
Public sharing links need inbound reach: keep out of stories
Face recognition is a feature, not a claim to amplify
open-notebook: [cloud-link] Supports 18 plus providers including cloud ones. Ollama is the local path.
[heavy] Podcast-style audio overviews need a speech model.
Install form has OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Groq key fields: leave blank; Ollama is the local path.
Podcast style audio overviews need a speech model: do not mention.
Capture shows sample notebook content, not personal data.
obsidian: [licence] Obsidian is not open source. Do not call it open source.
[note] An Obsidian MCP entry exists so an agent can read and write the vault.
not open source (catalog: never say so)
listing says private and offline: do not repeat
notes are files on the Core, the app is streamed
grocy: [note] The listing is short. Describe pantry stock, shopping lists, recipes and chores only.
Short listing: describe pantry stock, shopping lists, recipes, tasks and habits only (catalog)
Upstream demo screenshot shows a dollar total: prices on screen
libretranslate: [note] Works offline once language models are downloaded.
Listing says "works fully offline": banned wording (sec-offline)
Likely already heavy in the existing stories
firefly-iii: [cloud-link] Bank import through GoCardless or Spectre is an outside service. CSV import stays local.
[claims] Bookkeeping tool. No financial advice and no savings promises.
marketplace: Replaces lists Mint, which Intuit retired in 2024.
beatsync: Rights to the music are the household's; the app plays what you upload
Do not print the millisecond-accurate sync claim or any timing figure
Public URL field is optional; leave it blank for home-network use
cryptgeon: Notes live only in RAM: a restart of the app wipes every unread note
Do not repeat the listing's encryption wording (sec-absolute); say a note opens once and is gone
Overlaps Enclosed and PrivateBin: one burn-after-reading tool per household
influxdb2: QA screenshot is the welcome page.
Needs something writing to it (Home Assistant or sensors).
code-server: [cloud-link] The editor and the files are on the Core and it asks for no cloud key. Installing an extension fetches it from an outside extension registry (the upstream default is Open VSX), and a coding agent extension c

[claims] The listing says "access it from anywhere"; do not write that (the sheet leaves remote access unfinished). Say the editor opens in the laptop's browser on the home network. Never claim it matches a hosted coding
[note] One password set at install (plus an optional sudo password). It is one household tool, not a separate account per person.
[note] Persona decision 2026-10-15 (Liam Broza): re-admitted from the old cloud-or-developer exclusion for the builder archetype. The manifest has no API key field.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
it-tools: Listing says it keeps working with the network unplugged: do not repeat (install and updates use the internet).
Everything computes in the browser; the Core serves static files only.
veloren: [note] Headless game server; no web interface. Players use the game client.
[claims] No frame rate or player-count claims.
[qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
Image is the weekly build: a moving tag, so clients can fall out of step with the server
opencut: [qa] No QA screenshot on origin/main (e2e/screenshots). It is listed and installable, but nobody has recorded a verified run.
Footage stays in the browser's storage on the editing machine, not on the Core
Compose points NEXT_PUBLIC_MARBLE_API_URL at api.marblecms.com with a disabled key: an outside call to check
No QA run and no screenshot
excalidraw: [note] amd64 only. An Excalidraw MCP entry exists for agents.
marketplace: Manifest source points to ozencb/excalidraw-persist, a 105-star wrapper, not excalidraw/excalidraw.
booklore: [cloud-link] Fetches metadata and covers from outside.
jotty: Public share links need outside reach
Everything is Markdown and JSON files, no database
endurain: [cloud-link] Optional sync with Strava and Garmin Connect. Bulk GPX and FIT upload is local.
Strava and Garmin sync are outside links: say bulk upload is the local path
GPS history is location data: story must not map a home address
dropgate: The QA build shows "Standard uploads are disabled on this server": only direct transfer worked in the capture
"Beyond your network" sharing needs outside reach to the Core
searxng: [cloud-link] It queries outside search engines for you. Say "private search", not "offline search".
cloud-link: the engines still see the query from the Core
listing says users are not tracked: do not repeat
librespeed: Say "the link to the Core" or "the Wi-Fi in this room"; never "internet speed"
No speed figures in copy (num rules): show the act, not a number
Listing says "privacy-focused" and "no tracking": do not repeat
